messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Increased 5xx error rate observed for cross-region gateway (eu-west2 -> us-east1) — starts 2418765420. Aggregated 5xx spike: 12% -> 38% p50 latency increase. Paging on-call: @alice_oncall :rotating_light:
alice_oncall: Got it — looking. Any throttles or deploys?
emily_eng: No deploys on the routing service in the last 30m from CI. I see a policy push scheduled earlier today but last successful rollout was 2h ago.
bob_network: Seeing asymmetric route counts from edge LB -> regional router. Some traffic is being pinned to us-east1 despite client geolocation EU. Suspect pinning header mis-evaluation.
carla_sre: Reproducing a sample trace where request goes eu-edge -> us-east1 -> eu-redis and TTL causes long RTT. Dumping one example: `trace_id=abc123 route=[eu-edge,us-east1,eu-redis]` latency 1.8s.
dave_support: Several customers in EU reported elevated latencies and occasional transaction failures. Support queue ticked up ~40 tickets in 12m.
alice_oncall: Starting incident room. Objectives: 1) identify root cause (routing policy vs infra). 2) mitigate to restore latency/5xx. 3) communicate customer impact.
carla_sre: Check: AZ health for eu-west2 shows partial AZ outage (eu-west2-b degraded) beginning ~2418765300 per cloud provider. Some regional capacity reduced.
bob_network: That could explain fallback routing. Our smart-routing policy has a preference weight that tries to avoid degraded AZs but has a bug: when a region is partially degraded it flips pinning incorrectly and routes cross-region instead of same-region fallback.
emily_eng: Paging @deploy-bot for the routing policy rollout history.
deploy-bot: Policy rollout `route-selector-v3` was promoted 3h ago. 7 steps completed, last rollout step 2418763430. No rollbacks logged.
bob_network: Ok the recent policy introduced a heuristics change for latency-based pinning. There's a mis-eval when `region_health.score` is NA — config treats NA as 0 (healthy) instead of unknown, so traffic gets pinned to remote healthy region.
alice_oncall: Immediate mitigations?
carla_sre: Short term: disable new `route-selector-v3` by toggling control-plane override to `route-selector-v2`. That should force old behavior. Risk: rollout flip across many routers — potential churn.
bob_network: Alternative: add emergency routing rule to prefer same-region fallback even if pin evaluation NA. That’s a config toggle with smaller blast radius.
emily_eng: I can push the emergency config change in 2-3 minutes. Will prepare rollback plan.
alice_oncall: Do it. Post commands and confirmation.
emily_eng: Executing emergency override: `curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/api/overrides -d '{"selector":"route-selector","version":"v2-compat","reason":"emergency pin misroute"}'`
deploy-bot: Override accepted. New active selector: route-selector (v2-compat). Change propagated to 85% of routers in 60s, 100% in 140s.
carla_sre: Monitoring metrics... 2min after override 5xx down from 38% -> 9%. p50 latency back to baseline ~120ms.
dave_support: Noticing reduced ticket inflow. I'll draft a short status for customers: "We observed increased errors and latencies in EU due to cross-region routing; an emergency config rollback is in progress; service is returning to normal."
alice_oncall: Good. Next: investigate root cause deeper and plan permanent fix. Who owns the policy code?
bob_network: That’s owned by routing team (me + emily). I’ll create a PR to correct NA handling to treat unknown as degraded and add unit tests.
emily_eng: Also propose adding a canary check in control plane to validate `region_health` sampling to avoid NA holes.
\arbitrary-note: :eyes: (reaction from `carla_sre`)
carla_sre: Postmortem items: 1) bugfix in selector logic. 2) add metric for rate of NA in region_health. 3) oncall playbook: prefer emergency override path vs full selector rollback. 4) customer comms template.
dave_support: Customer impact estimate: Affected requests ~ 0.9% of global traffic concentrated in EU for ~18 minutes window; ~40 support tickets; no data loss.
alice_oncall: Assign follow-ups: `bob_network` -> PR to fix eval (ETA 4h). `emily_eng` -> canary control-plane probe (ETA 24h). `carla_sre` -> postmortem writeup (ETA 48h). `dave_support` -> finalize outbound message (ETA 30m).
bob_network: Starting PR now: `fix(route-selector): treat region_health NA as degraded (#487)`
emily_eng: I'll schedule a canary rollout for next maintenance window and add an automatic rollback if 5xx > 1% in 10m.
dave_support: Draft sent to legal for review, will send to customers in 20m.
alice_oncall: Closing live incident now — monitoring in watch window for 2h. If regressions appear we re-open. Good job team.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: 5xx spike mitigated via emergency override. Duration: 18 minutes. Severity: SEV2 -> monitoring. Channel: incidents.
carla_sre: One more note — collect traces flagged with `route-mismatch` tag and attach to postmortem.
bob_network: Added logs and a sample policy evaluation dump: ```{"request_id":"abc123","region_health":{"eu-west2":"NA","us-east1":"healthy"},"eval_result":"pin_to_us-east1","selector_version":"v3"}```
emily_eng: We'll push the hotfix to `route-selector` and include the unit test harness in the same PR.
alice_oncall: Thanks all. If there are any emerging issues, page me directly. :thumbsup:
